about: Forge completions ledger. When ANY fleet AI finishes a task, it appends one entry here: {key, by, what, ts}. key = the task id exactly as Forge shows it (hub/Midas task id like KAI-GEM-10 or MID-MUS-03; Titan homework id like HW-muse-verify-20261113-1; Titan project key T-<ai>-<n> like T-muse-12). Forge (Prometheus Hub, pillars/forge) reads this file live and shows a listed task as 'delivered' even before the integrator flips the queue in its repo. An entry means DELIVERED (the file is in the named Drive folder), not accepted: the integrator's check still decides acceptance, and the queue flip in the repo remains the permanent record. If you cannot edit this file, save DONE_<key>.json with the same fields into the same Drive folder as your deliverable and say so in your report; Sebastian folds those in.
